extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors/editors attempting to create or locate an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for contributors who want to create or find a missing Wikipedia article (here: 'Roast jokes'), including account requirements, search checks, and procedural steps if a page was deleted or recently created.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or not autoconfirmed you cannot create the page; create an account and meet autoconfirmation criteria before attempting to create the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are unable to create the article directly (e.g., lack autoconfirmation), submit a draft via the article wizard or use the 'request a new article' process so other editors can assist or review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles before creating
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Roast jokes" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for alternative titles or spellings and search Wikipedia to avoid creating a duplicate article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to this title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding incoming links can reveal related content, redirects, or established coverage that may make a separate article unnecessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay / purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before recreating content, allow time for the database to update or use the purge function to refresh the page view.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirect suggestion
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and, when appropriate, create redirects rather than duplicate pages to guide readers to the correct title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleted page — check the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a page was previously deleted, consult the deletion log and post-deletion guidance to understand reasons and whether recreation is appropriate.
